test_item_verbatim: Icons will exist for “AUX Cameras” in the camera views

tcs.tc_title: AUX Cameras icons exist in the camera views
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. A wired AUX camera is connected
4. The rear view camera image is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Read the rear view camera image and check that an "AUX Cameras" icon is present
2. Select the "AUX Cameras" icon
3. Read the HU display and check that an AUX camera view is displayed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The "AUX Cameras" icon is shown in the rear view camera image
2. The "AUX Cameras" icon registers the selection
3. An AUX camera view is displayed
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.split_reason: AUX Cameras icons exist in the camera views
tcs.test_item:
Icons will exist for “AUX Cameras” in the camera views

(AUX Cameras icons exist in the camera views)

reasoning: §27.2.2.1 為 `Recommended Labels/Icons` 節下之一句；`“AUX Cameras”` 為逐字標籤。與 `-050`（§27.2.1.1）之分工：後者驗控制項**所在之表面**（second surface，兩個視角），本列驗**圖示之存在與可用**。
